summary: Audited eight vendors' public product pages on the same eleven characterisation and quality-documentation fields, Signal's own page included and audited first.
outcome: Artifact created; half the vendors publish a particle count and one publishes the method behind it, while passage number, isolation method and cell line are absent across all eight.

summary: Compared candidate active ingredients for an intranasal product against human intranasal precedent, regulatory class, and stability profile.
outcome: First formulation pass; excipient system, device, and a final verdict deferred to a later run.

summary: Re-screened Japanese clinical-trial data under revised, earlier-stage screening criteria focused on regenerative medicine.
outcome: One candidate cleared all screening criteria; several partial matches recorded for follow-up.

summary: Screened completed clinical-trial data against out-licensing criteria for a US buyer.
outcome: No candidates cleared all screening criteria this run.

summary: Compiled every product-specification parameter with its evidentiary basis and confidence level, cross-checked against the only public human-dosing precedent.
outcome: Artifact created; found that several published product numbers do not reconcile with each other or with precedent.

summary: Catalogued the questions a contract manufacturer requires answered before it will quote cGMP extracellular-vesicle production, and checked which are currently answerable.
outcome: Artifact created; found that none of the core manufacturing questions can currently be answered in full.

summary: Mapped where intranasal exosome products can lawfully be administered, for what indications, under which statute — Florida and US federal law, from primary sources.
outcome: Artifact created; found a conflict between a public regulatory claim and the underlying statute's actual scope.
